title: [Automatic update for 2025-09-21]
description:
Update manuf, services enterprise numbers, translations, and other items.

manuf failed.

notes.body: I'm not sure. When I tried loading https://bitbucket.org/bluetooth-SIG/public/src/main/assigned_numbers/ in my browser, it initially returned a 404, but after a few minutes started returning a repository directory listing. @JaapKeuter any idea what's going on?
If you look at the source files there, it does seem that those company identifiers and company UUIDs were removed in commits upstream six days ago. So I guess they are no longer registered.
